hypothesis.hypothesis: A model jointly pretrained to estimate acoustic-support deficiency and adapt its generation loss before textual decoding will produce fewer fluent unsupported spans than an equivalent model protected only by post-decoding detection.

attestation.target_transcript: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
attestation.competitor_transcript: The cat sat on the mat today

limitations: Only the risk head is trained; Whisper encoder/decoder weights are frozen.
The 'joint' arm trains the risk head with gradients flowing through the encoder, but with frozen Whisper weights this is a proxy for full joint fine-tuning.
The corpus is small (6 conditions from 2 TTS sentences). This is a proof-of-pipeline, not a statistically powered experiment.
The post-decoding filter uses a threshold of 0.5 on the risk head output.
Full joint fine-tuning of Whisper requires GPU and is out of scope for this run.
